versions.changelog: Setup installs the shared OCR venv from the base skill's pinned requirements-adb.txt instead of an unpinned pip list, and ($PY $BASE/ocr_bridge.py) invocations now work from any working directory.

All documented commands now use $BASE (the appium-android-adb base skill directory) instead of a bare 'ocr_bridge.py' filename, which only worked when the working directory happened to be the appium skill dir. Adds a Requirements section and a preflight check, since ClawHub has no dependency resolver and installing this skill alone yields a broken one.
venv path renamed .venv-12306 -> .venv-adb, matching the other ADB skills.
Add Safety & Consent section (confirm before checkout, PIN user-provided in-memory only, fingerprint manual, private screenshot storage).
New skill: Pinduoduo purchase automation via ADB. Proven end-to-end 2026-08-30 (spec selection + FLAG_SECURE payment via a11y + PIN pad + fingerprint handoff + 直接免拼).
